items.title: Streaming service Tidal is banning fully-AI-generated music
items.excerpt: Tidal will reject and remove wholly AI-generated tracks from December 9, the first major DSP to ban fully AI music outright; AI-assisted hybrid tracks remain allowed.

items.title: Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month
items.excerpt: Tidal says it will ban and purge fully AI-generated tracks starting next month, while Spotify, YouTube Music and Apple Music still have not banned AI music.

items.title: Tidal Is the First Streaming Service to Ban AI Music
items.excerpt: Tidal said it will start removing all wholly AI-generated music from its platform and reject future uploads, deleting an estimated 29 million tracks from December 9.

items.title: Dutch collecting society BumaStemra threatens legal action against AI background music supplier YourNeuroTune, alleging it uses Suno
items.excerpt: Buma/Stemra says Dutch AI background-music supplier YourNeuroTune sells Suno-generated tracks to businesses as royalty-free music and has threatened legal action — a collecting society moving against an AI music vendor rather than the model maker.

items.title: Aussie MPs' new AI proposals 'disguise' pro-big tech copyright reforms as 'a favour to creators', says ARIA boss
items.excerpt: Australia's Joint Select Committee on AI published its report proposing copyright reforms to give AI companies 'certainty'; ARIA says no reform is needed and accuses MPs of gaslighting creators.

items.title: ARIA Pushes Back on AI Committee Recommendations
items.excerpt: ARIA rejected the basis of the copyright recommendations in the Joint Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence's report, released today.

items.title: n-Track Studio 11 released with AI Assistant, VocalTune 2.0 and more
items.excerpt: n-Track Studio 11 adds an in-DAW AI assistant that answers recording, editing and mixing questions and can make changes inside your song, plus note-by-note VocalTune 2.0, Spectral Edit and ARA support.

items.title: iZotope's Nectar 5 introduces a clever new way to add effects to vocals, one word at a time
items.excerpt: Nectar 5 adds Moments, an AI-powered lyric-transcribing ARA plugin that lets you apply vocal effects to individual words via a text editor, plus an enhanced AI Vocal Assistant that designs a processing chain from your take.

items.title: '설죽화' 품은 AI 걸그룹 '서리아'의 실험 [AI & 음악]
items.excerpt: 카메라·연습실·스튜디오 없이 음악방송 무대 영상, 브이로그, 브랜드 협업까지 AI로 제작하는 4인조 K-팝 AI 걸그룹 '서리아(SEORIA)'의 제작 방식을 다룬다.

items.title: 음저협, 30일 'AI 활용 음악 신탁 기준' 회원 공청회
items.excerpt: 한국음악저작권협회가 30일 'AI 활용 음악 신탁 기준 마련을 위한 회원 공청회'를 열어 AI 활용곡의 저작권 등록·신탁 기준에 창작자 의견을 반영한다.

items.title: 음반업계 100% "AI 무단 복제 막을 퍼블리시티권 보호 강화해야"
items.excerpt: 대음협 AI 정책 설문에서 응답 음반제작·유통사 전원이 AI 시대 아티스트 얼굴·목소리 무단 복제를 막을 퍼블리시티권 보호 강화가 시급하다고 답했다.

items.title: 대음협, AI 음원에 "책임 있는 학습·가수 보호·공정 유통을"
items.excerpt: 한국대중음악산업협회가 회원사 AI 정책 설문 결과와 함께 '책임 있는 학습·가수 보호·공정 유통' 3대 원칙을 발표했다. 조건 없는 TDM 면책이나 선사용·후보상에 찬성한 기업은 한 곳도 없었다.

items.title: IteraSong: LLM-Guided Iterative Symbolic Music Creation in a Web DAW
items.excerpt: A web DAW where an LLM maps natural-language requests onto MCP editing tools across song, track, section and bar scopes, supporting a generate-audition-edit-refine loop on a persistent multi-track project with undo/redo.

items.title: ARRANGE: Agentic Skills for Layering Vocals
items.excerpt: An agentic system that adds a singing voice to piano recordings via readable intermediate artifacts and composer approval checkpoints; an editable Score Canvas exposes note, syllable and pronunciation decisions before open audio models render.

items.title: PopMelodyGen: A Copyright-Aware Platform for Controllable Pop-Melody Generation
items.excerpt: Pretrains a melody model on rule-synthesized melodies with auditable provenance, then adapts it on a small licensed pop corpus — a copyright-aware route to controllable melody generation with an interactive creator interface.
